data.name: Bahu
data.gender_notes: Bahu is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Bahu is derived from the Arabic language and is rooted in the Quranic concept of a gift or blessing bestowed upon an individual by Allah. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby boy in Islamic tradition. The name Bahu carries the meaning “Gift from Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bahu usually hope their child will grow to embody gift from allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's boundless generosity and blessings.
data.etymology: Bahu belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift from Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bahu total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: بها
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يُشير إلى العلاقة بين الشخص وأهله
in_arabic.long_meaning: يشير اسم بهو إلى العلاقة بين الفرد وأهله، وهي علاقة رابطة وواصلة، تُشير إلى الحب والتواصل بين الأفراد وتعبر عن الصلة العائلية. في اللغة العربية، كان هذا التعريف شائعاً في العصور الوسطى، حيث كان يُستخدم لوصف العلاقة بين الأب والأبناء، والوالدين، والأقارب. في هذه العلاقة، يُعتبر الشخص الذي يحمل اسم بهو كائناً معيناً، متصلاً بجميع أفراد أسرته، ويُعتبر هذا التعريف ذا أهمية كبيرة في الإسلام، حيث يعبر عن التبعية والطاعة، والتواصل والوئام. في بعض المناطق، يُستخدم هذا الاسم أيضًا لوصف شخص ما الذي يُمثل عائلة أو قبيلة معينة. في هذه السياقات، يُعتبر اسم بهو اسمًا شريفًا ومعنويًا، يُعبر عن العلاقة بين الفرد وأهله، وهي علاقة رابطة وواصلة.

in_english.long_meaning: The name Bahu refers to the connection between an individual and their relatives, which is a bond of love and communication between people. This name was commonly used in the Middle Ages to describe the relationship between a father and his children, parents, and relatives. In Islamic tradition, this name has significant importance, as it represents submission and obedience, as well as communication and unity. In some regions, this name is also used to describe a person who represents a family or tribe. In these contexts, the name Bahu is a noble and meaningful name, representing the connection between an individual and their relatives, which is a bond of love and communication.
